title: Roasted Harissa, Tomato and Chickpea Spaghetti
changes_from_base: The tomato sauce is roasted in the oven with chickpeas, red onion, sun-dried tomato and harissa, then stirred together with ricotta and Parmesan.
summary: Spaghetti tossed in the baking dish with jammy roasted cherry tomatoes, chickpeas, red onion and harissa, made creamy with ricotta.

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, peeled and lightly crushed
sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained and chopped
fine sea salt or table salt
fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.5%)
ingredients.note: about 2.5 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Set it to 220 °C (200 °C fan) with a shelf in the middle.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: In the baking dish, toss the cherry tomatoes, chickpeas, onion, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, harissa, oil and salt until everything is coated. Roast 30-40 min until the tomatoes have burst and the mixture looks jammy; the dry oven heat concentrates the juices into a sauce without any simmering.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Crush the soft garlic cloves with a fork and stir them back through.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Meanwhile boil the spaghetti in 3 litres salted water until al dente. Save a mug of the water and drain.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Tip the pasta into the hot dish with the ricotta and Parmesan and toss, adding splashes of the water until the sauce is creamy and coats every strand. Serve straight from the dish.

tips: Use a mild harissa; strength varies widely between brands.
Let the tomatoes really collapse in the oven, which is where the sauce comes from.
A drizzle of olive oil at the table rounds out the heat.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
